name: cidr
desc: Expand, collapse, split and test IPv4/IPv6 networks; check whether an IP is inside a range

name: corscheck
desc: Probe endpoints for CORS origin reflection, wildcard + credentials, and null-origin bypass

name: cvedb
desc: Fetch CVE detail from NVD, exploit status from CISA KEV, and exploitation likelihood from EPSS

name: dirb
desc: HTTP path/directory brute-forcer with automatic soft-404 detection and extension expansion

name: dnsdump
desc: Dump A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/SOA/CNAME/CAA/SRV records; decode SPF+DMARC; optional PTR and zone-transfer test

name: envleak
desc: Check hosts for exposed .env, .git, .svn, backup archives, phpinfo and CI config files

name: gitleak
desc: Walk `git log -p` and flag secrets that were committed (even if later removed) plus .env/.pem blobs

name: graphqlscan
desc: Detect live GraphQL endpoints, test introspection exposure, and list queries/mutations/subscriptions

name: hashid
desc: Identify hash type by format/prefix/length, or generate md5/sha1/sha256/sha512 for input

name: headers
desc: Audit HTTP security headers (HSTS/CSP/XFO/Referrer-Policy...) and grade the response

name: hostheader
desc: Test Host / X-Forwarded-Host / X-Forwarded-For handling for cache poisoning and reset-poisoning risk

name: jsenum
desc: Extract API paths, hidden routes, domains, cloud buckets and secret-like strings from JS files

name: jwtpeek
desc: Decode JWT header/payload, flag alg=none, missing expiry, weak claims, and HMAC-crackable secrets

name: openapiscan
desc: Fetch an OpenAPI spec and report auth coverage, sensitive endpoints, and unauthenticated operations

name: paramfuzz
desc: Probe a URL with candidate parameters to find hidden/reflected/reachable ones

name: payloadx
desc: Encode/decode payloads for filters: url, double-url, base64, hex, unicode, html-entity, sql-comment, leet

name: portscan
desc: Async TCP connect port scanner with service banner grab and JSON/CSV output

name: probe
desc: Probe many hosts at once: status, title, server, tech, TLS expiry, redirect chain — CSV/JSON out

name: ratelimit
desc: Sequentially probe a login/OTP endpoint to measure throttling, lockout and Retry-After behaviour

name: redirectcheck
desc: Test URL parameters for open-redirect behaviour with a payload matrix and 3xx/Location evidence

name: robtex
desc: Pull RDAP registration data plus reverse-IP co-hosted domains for infrastructure mapping

name: secretscan
desc: Scan source trees for hardcoded secrets: AWS/GCP/Stripe/Slack keys, private keys, JWTs, DB URLs

name: sqli
desc: Parametric SQLi triage: error signatures, boolean differential, and time-delay probes with evidence

name: ssrfprobe
desc: Inject internal/loopback URLs into params to spot SSRF: timing, error text and metadata echoes

name: statusfuzz
desc: Build a route x method status matrix (no-auth vs bogus-token) to find open endpoints

name: subdomain
desc: Concurrent DNS subdomain brute-forcer with wildcard detection and JSON output

name: takeover
desc: Resolve subdomains, match response bodies against 40+ dangling-service fingerprints, report CNAME target

name: techstack
desc: Query the OSV.dev API for known vulnerabilities affecting a package+version across ecosystems

name: tlsinfo
desc: Inspect a host's TLS certificate: subject, SANs, issuer, expiry countdown, protocol version

name: vulncheck
desc: Static audit of a web project: dangerous sinks, missing auth checks, insecure randoms, upload handling

name: wafdetect
desc: Identify WAF/CDN by headers, cookies and blocked-payload behaviour; report likely bypass posture

name: wayback
desc: Harvest historical URLs for a domain from the Wayback CDX index, filtered and deduped by path

name: webfinger
desc: Passive tech fingerprint: server, framework, CMS, JS libs, analytics, CDN, WAF

name: wordgen
desc: Generate context-aware wordlists (names/dates/company/leet/mutations) for authorised recovery testing
usage: node tools/wordgen.js --name "Budi Santoso" --nick budi --year 1998 --domain acme.id --out words.txt

name: xssprobe
desc: Send a canary into parameters/headers and report reflected contexts that can break out
